fim.nao_conectou: The connection did not open. Try again.

erros.NotAllowedError: The browser did not allow the microphone or camera. Allow them in the site permissions.
erros.NotFoundError: No microphone or camera found on this device.
erros.NotReadableError: Another program is using the microphone or camera.
erros.voz_desligada: Calls are turned off on this server.
erros.voz_sem_retransmissao: The relay server did not answer. Without it the call does not open: it is what hides your address.
erros.voz_sem_canal: The call channel did not open. Try again.
erros.sem_chat: Open the chat on this device before calling.
erros.chamada_nao_saiu: The ring did not go out: no device of the other person is ready.
erros.dm_aguardando: The conversation has not been accepted yet.
erros.dm_identidade_mudou: The other person's identity changed. Check the code before calling.
erros.dm_exige_comparar: The other person's identity changed. Compare the code before calling.
erros.dm_fora_do_registro: The public log does not confirm the other person's identity. Calling is not possible.
erros.outro: Could not make the call. Try again.

privacidade: End-to-end encrypted. The ring travels inside the encrypted conversation; voice and video go through the relay, which cannot hear or see them. No call log is kept.
limite: The ring only arrives if Alumia is open on the other person's device, and it can take up to a minute and a half.
